board: Generic 1.3" 240x240 IPS TFT LCD module ST7789 SPI, 7-pin GND VCC SCL SDA RES DC BLK (no CS), e.g. Probots 1.3 inch 240x240 IPS TFT LCD Module ST7789 SPI
reason: Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator text-on-screen test, PCB DRC clean, footprint, LCSC). Driver follows the ST7789VW datasheet (reset 10 us/120 ms, SWRESET, SLPOUT 120 ms, COLMOD 0x55, MADCTL with 240x320 RAM offsets, INVON, NORON, DISPON, CASET/RASET/RAMWR) and uses SPI mode 3 because CS is tied low on the module.
